items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: But Don thought that I could do it, and thank God he let me try.

ctx.x: I said “Don, we’ve got to do this right.” And he says “yeah but I can’t find it either.” So he said, “try it.” And we put in little things like, gee if you touch yourself three times and then come in then it’ll be all right.

It was very tricky, very tricky. But we did enjoy it, and then I got to do “Bachianas Brasileiras,” which was something I would never dream of attempting. But Don thought that I could do it, and thank God he let me try.
And we did those charts, plus several others with the Syracuse Symphony, what year though, I can’t remember.
